Governing_Process: Elliptic SSA velocity solve at fixed geometry H^k, s^k
Mathematical_Variable_and_Norm: Relative residual norm: ||R_u||_2 / ||R_0||_2 and infinity norm: ||u^(k+1) - u^k||_inf
Stagnation_and_Failure_Handling: Line search backtracking (SNESLINESEARCHBT); if Picard/Newton stalls, reduce pseudo-transient step or damp viscosity update
Physical_Interpretation_and_Distinction: Measures algebraic convergence of non-linear effective viscosity nu(eps_dot) and basal traction beta_b(u). Solves equilibrium at a FROZEN instant in time. Does NOT move grounding line or ice front.
Verification_Test_Protocol: Evaluate residual reduction across Newton iterations at fixed geometry; verify quadratic convergence in asymptotic regime.

Convergence_Category: Sub-Grid Grounding Line Flotation State Convergence
Governing_Process: Determination of cell grounded fraction f_gr within a single Picard/Newton iteration
Mathematical_Variable_and_Norm: Max change in sub-grid fraction: max|f_gr^(k+1) - f_gr^k| across all boundary cells
Convergence_Threshold_Criterion: max|f_gr^(k+1) - f_gr^k| < 1.0e-04 (equivalent to sub-grid position change < 0.05 m)
Stagnation_and_Failure_Handling: If sub-grid state oscillates between adjacent nodes, freeze f_gr for 2 Newton steps or apply sub-grid regularized Heaviside smoothing
Physical_Interpretation_and_Distinction: Prevents numerical chattering / limit cycles where velocity changes alter flotation, which alters basal drag, destabilizing the Newton solver.
Verification_Test_Protocol: Monitor f_gr oscillation count per time step; reject time step if f_gr fails to stabilize within 30 iterations.

Governing_Process: Physical movement of grounding line position between discrete time steps t and t + Delta t
Mathematical_Variable_and_Norm: Grounding line velocity: v_GL = |x_GL(t + Delta t) - x_GL(t)| / Delta t
Convergence_Threshold_Criterion: CFL-type stability constraint: |Delta x_GL| <= 1.0 * Delta x per physical time step (Delta x_GL <= 500 m / dt)
Stagnation_and_Failure_Handling: If physical GL migration exceeds 1 cell width per time step, reduce physical time step Delta t -> Delta t / 2 dynamically
Physical_Interpretation_and_Distinction: Governed by physical mass continuity and ice advection, NOT by Newton iterations. Represents true glaciological retreat or advance.
Verification_Test_Protocol: MISMIP+ benchmark experiments ice1r (retreat) and ice1ra (re-advance); verify continuous smooth GL trajectory without unphysical jumps.

Governing_Process: Sensitivity of steady-state grounding line position to spatial mesh resolution
Mathematical_Variable_and_Norm: Grounding line position discrepancy: |x_GL(Delta x) - x_GL_ref| / x_GL_ref
Convergence_Threshold_Criterion: Convergence order: Error scales as O(Delta x) or O(Delta x^2); GL position change < 2.0 km between 500 m and 250 m grids
Stagnation_and_Failure_Handling: If 500 m grid produces > 5% GL position offset relative to 250 m mesh, activate SEP3 sub-grid flotation interpolation
Physical_Interpretation_and_Distinction: Tests whether physical boundary layer at grounding line is sufficiently resolved to prevent artificial numerical pinning.
Verification_Test_Protocol: MISMIP+ standardized grid refinement suite at Delta x = 2000 m, 1000 m, 500 m, 250 m.

Governing_Process: Hysteresis and unphysical pinning during cyclic ocean melting perturbation
Mathematical_Variable_and_Norm: Hysteresis offset: |x_GL_final - x_GL_initial| after complete melt reversal cycle
Convergence_Threshold_Criterion: Reversibility envelope: |x_GL_final - x_GL_initial| < 1.0 * Delta x (500 m) on unpinned bed slope
Stagnation_and_Failure_Handling: If irreversible pinning occurs on retrograde slope, inspect sub-grid drag interpolation scheme and refine mesh locally
Physical_Interpretation_and_Distinction: Verifies that numerical discretization does not introduce artificial friction or spurious hysteresis on overdeepened bed troughs.
Verification_Test_Protocol: MISMIP+ ice1ra experiment: 100 years of high sub-shelf melt followed by 100 years of zero melt; verify return to initial grounding position.
